title: Подія цифрової фіксації
roles: R03; R01 для первинної польової фіксації
fields_and_relations: Пристрій/оператор/ПЗ, recording_form, settings, час, ordered files.
required_interaction: Додати outputs/manifest; recapture створює нові подію й файли, born-digital не вимагає носія.

implementation.view_model: Capture provenance, ordered outputs, immutable files and manifest; new capture/representation/files on repeat; session capture without physical object
limitations: Capture creates small text fixtures; no scanner, recorder or media hardware.
capture_output.plan_item_id remains null because source schema declares a composite capture_plan_item key; matching uses pinned plan revision + ordered component labels.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store, fixture version 3; incremental migration preserves prior user changes
permissions: media.write / physical.write / intake.send / intake.receive / legacy.write / legacy.review / capture.field, explicit archive grants
implementation.atomicity: Authorize and compare expected revision/package state; mutate clone; validate FK/type/version/hash; commit atomically.
